ns2:section.sectionText: Covers basic principles of business strategy; understanding of financial accounting and budgeting; the importance of ethics; principles of leadership; and the importance of the global business environment. Non-Degree seeking students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of the department. To request enrollment, please complete the “Non-Degree Enrollment Request Form” here: https://sbc.illinois.edu/non-degree-request-information/https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/9478165.
